ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm GPO-mediated wiper rollout (HermeticWiper / CaddyWiper / ARGUEPATCH pattern)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature 2022-2024 Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard / IRIDIUM / UAC-0082) destructive-attack chain in Ukraine: a domain-admin foothold pushes a wiper via a GPO Scheduled / Immediate Task that stages the payload in a writable system path (\Windows\Temp, \ProgramData, \SYSVOL, \PerfLogs), then triggers near-simultaneous execution under svchost/taskhostw/WmiPrvSE across many hosts. The combination of (writable-path child) + (Task Scheduler parentage) + (mass parallel execution) is the differentiator from generic LOLBin abuse.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime, dc(Processes.dest) as host_count, values(Processes.dest) as hosts, values(Processes.user) as users, values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents, values(Processes.process) as cmdlines, values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="svchost.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="taskhostw.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="WmiPrvSE.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*") AND NOT (Processes.process_name="MsMpEng.exe" OR Processes.process_name="MpCmdRun.exe" OR Processes.process_name="MsSense.exe" OR Processes.process_name="SenseIR.exe") by Processes.process_path Processes.process_name | eval span_seconds = lastTime - firstTime | where host_count >= 3 AND span_seconds <= 1800 | rename Processes.* AS * | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let MinHosts = 3;          // GPO push typically lands on >=3 hosts before SOC sees it
let MaxSpanSeconds = 1800; // 30-min window — characteristic of gpupdate /force fan-out
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("svchost.exe","taskhostw.exe","wmiprvse.exe")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\SYSVOL\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where FileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","MsSense.exe","SenseIR.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceId),
            Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 25),
            Users = make_set(AccountName, 10),
            ParentCmds = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 5),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            SampleSHA = any(SHA256),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by FolderPath, FileName
| where HostCount >= MinHosts
| extend SpanSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where SpanSeconds <= MaxSpanSeconds
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let MinHosts = 3;
let MaxSpanSeconds = 1800;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any (@"\svchost.exe", @"\taskhostw.exe", @"\WmiPrvSE.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\SYSVOL\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where NewProcessName !has @"\MsMpEng.exe" and NewProcessName !has @"\MpCmdRun.exe" and NewProcessName !has @"\MsSense.exe"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Computer),
            Hosts = make_set(Computer, 25),
            Users = make_set(SubjectUserName, 10),
            ParentCmds = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by NewProcessName
| where HostCount >= MinHosts
| extend SpanSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where SpanSeconds <= MaxSpanSeconds
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(svchost|taskhostw|wmiprvse)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(Windows\\Temp|ProgramData|SYSVOL|PerfLogs|Users\\Public)\\/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(MsMpEng|MpCmdRun|MsSense|SenseIR)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([ImageFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=host_count), min(_time, as=firstSeen), max(_time, as=lastSeen), collect([ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| host_count >= 3
| span_seconds := lastSeen - firstSeen
| span_seconds <= 1800

ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm NotPetya/Prestige worming: LSASS dump on a single host followed by mass Type-3 fan-out
ucs.description: Catches Sandworm's post-foothold lateral-movement signature observed in NotPetya (2017), Prestige ransomware against Ukrainian/Polish logistics (Oct 2022), and ongoing CERT-UA campaigns: harvest credentials via Mimikatz / comsvcs.dll MiniDump / procdump-against-lsass on one staging host, then immediately authenticate Network-logon (Type 3) to >=5 targets within an hour. The LSASS-access primitive alone is generic credential theft; the temporal correlation with a single-source SMB / WMI burst is the Sandworm worming fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count, min(_time) as dump_time, values(Processes.process) as dump_cmd, values(Processes.user) as dump_user, values(Processes.process_name) as dump_proc from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" AND Processes.process="*MiniDump*") OR Processes.process="*sekurlsa::*" OR Processes.process="*lsadump::*" OR Processes.process="*privilege::debug*" OR (Processes.process_name="procdump*.exe" AND Processes.process="*lsass*")) by Processes.dest | rename Processes.dest AS src | join type=inner src [ | tstats `summariesonly` count, dc(Authentication.dest) as target_count, values(Authentication.dest) as targets, values(Authentication.user) as logon_users, min(_time) as first_hop, max(_time) as last_hop from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" AND Authentication.signature_id=4624 AND Authentication.logon_type=3 by Authentication.src | rename Authentication.src AS src | where target_count >= 5 ] | eval span_seconds = last_hop - dump_time | where span_seconds >= 0 AND span_seconds <= 3600 | convert ctime(dump_time) ctime(first_hop) ctime(last_hop) | table src dump_time dump_proc dump_user dump_cmd target_count targets first_hop last_hop span_seconds logon_users
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let MinTargets = 5;       // empirical Prestige/NotPetya minimum fan-out before SOC sees pattern
let WindowMinutes = 60;   // dump-to-hop window; longer than 1h is most likely a different operator
let CredAccess = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has "MiniDump")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sekurlsa::","lsadump::","privilege::debug","sekurlsa::logonpasswords")
         or (FileName matches regex @"(?i)^procdump(\d+)?\.exe$" and ProcessCommandLine has_cs "lsass")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, SourceDeviceId = DeviceId, SourceDeviceName = DeviceName,
              DumpUser = AccountName, DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, DumpProc = FileName;
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| where LogonType == "Network"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where isnotempty(RemoteDeviceName)
| join kind=inner CredAccess on $left.RemoteDeviceName == $right.SourceDeviceName
| where Timestamp between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + WindowMinutes * 1m)
| summarize TargetCount = dcount(DeviceId),
            Targets = make_set(DeviceName, 25),
            LogonUsers = make_set(AccountName, 10),
            FirstHop = min(Timestamp),
            LastHop = max(Timestamp),
            DumpEvents = make_set(DumpCmd, 3)
            by SourceDeviceName, DumpTime, DumpUser, DumpProc
| where TargetCount >= MinTargets
| extend HopSpanSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastHop, FirstHop)
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let MinTargets = 5;
let WindowMinutes = 60;
let CredAccess = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith @"\rundll32.exe" and CommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and CommandLine has "MiniDump")
         or CommandLine has_any ("sekurlsa::","lsadump::","privilege::debug")
         or (NewProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\procdump(\d+)?\.exe$" and CommandLine has_cs "lsass")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, SourceHost = Computer,
              DumpUser = SubjectUserName, DumpCmd = CommandLine, DumpProc = NewProcessName;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4624
| where LogonType == 3
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where AccountType == "User"
| where isnotempty(WorkstationName)
| join kind=inner CredAccess on $left.WorkstationName == $right.SourceHost
| where TimeGenerated between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + WindowMinutes * 1m)
| summarize TargetCount = dcount(Computer),
            Targets = make_set(Computer, 25),
            LogonUsers = make_set(TargetUserName, 10),
            FirstHop = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastHop = max(TimeGenerated)
            by SourceHost, DumpTime, DumpUser, DumpProc
| where TargetCount >= MinTargets
| extend HopSpanSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastHop, FirstHop)
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Sandworm-style LSASS Credential Access via comsvcs.dll MiniDump or Mimikatz
id: 7f8c4b1d-3e7a-4d2b-9c1f-2a8e5d3b7c11
status: experimental
description: Detects the LSASS-dumping primitives Sandworm (G0034 / Seashell Blizzard) routinely uses as the credential-access step of its worming chain (NotPetya, Prestige, 2022-2024 Ukraine campaigns) — rundll32 invoking comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz commands (sekurlsa::, lsadump::), or procdump against lsass.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034/
    - https://cert.gov.ua/article/40089
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/10/14/new-prestige-ransomware-impacts-organizations-in-ukraine-and-poland/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/01/01
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1003.001
    - attack.g0034
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    comsvcs_minidump:
        Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'comsvcs.dll'
            - 'MiniDump'
    mimikatz_cmd:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'sekurlsa::'
            - 'lsadump::'
            - 'privilege::debug'
    procdump_lsass:
        Image|re|i: '\\procdump(\d+)?\.exe$'
        CommandLine|contains: 'lsass'
    condition: 1 of them
falsepositives:
    - Red-team exercises
    - Authorised forensic memory captures
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\Rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *Comsvcs.dll* OR *COMSVCS.DLL*) @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *MINIDUMP*)) OR @CommandLine:(*sekurlsa::* OR *lsadump::* OR *privilege::debug*) OR (@Image:(*\\procdump.exe OR *\\procdump64.exe OR *\\Procdump.exe OR *\\PROCDUMP.EXE OR *\\PROCDUMP64.EXE) @CommandLine:(*lsass* OR *LSASS* OR *Lsass*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i CommandLine=/comsvcs\.dll/i CommandLine=/MiniDump/i)
    OR CommandLine=/sekurlsa::/i
    OR CommandLine=/lsadump::/i
    OR CommandLine=/privilege::debug/i
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\procdump(\d+)?\.exe$/i CommandLine=/lsass/i)
  )
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true), min(_time, as=firstSeen), max(_time, as=lastSeen)])
ucs.rationale: Sandworm has used this exact two-stage pattern across nearly every major operation since 2017: NotPetya pulled creds from LSASS with a custom Mimikatz fork then worm-spread via SMB admin shares and WMI; the 2022 Prestige campaign and the multiple 2023-2024 CERT-UA tracked intrusions repeat the shape with comsvcs.dll MiniDump as the dump primitive of choice (signed-Microsoft LOLBin = minimal AV fri
